3 ضاجعهُ , (S, TA,) inf. n. مُضَاجَعَةٌ, He lay upon his side, or simply he lay, or slept, with him. (TA.) And ضَاجَعَهَا, (Msb, TA,) inf. n. as above, (Msb,) He lay, or slept, with her, (Msb, TA,) namely, his girl, or young woman, (TA,) in, or on, one bed, (Msb,) or in one innermost garment. (TA.) ―
-b2- And hence, ضاجعهُ الهَمُّ (tropical:) Anxiety clave to him. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
